# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting S2Code privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/shuv1337/s2code/security/advisories/new).
If GitHub private security advisories are not yet enabled on the repository, open a minimal
[GitHub issue](https://github.com/shuv1337/s2code/issues) asking for a private contact channel
without posting exploit details or sensitive information. Please do not disclose vulnerabilities
publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for our trust boundaries, threat model, and what counts as a
security finding.
